item.title: Legacy Cannabis Grand Opening in Minneapolis

item.title: Esko Boys Basketball Gets Back to .500 Mark After Home Win Against Mora
item.description: ESKO, Minn.- The Esko boys basketball team picked up their 4th win of the season on Friday, defeating Mora 67 to 66. They’ll next be in action on Saturday when they host Minneapolis North at 3 PM. Categories: Friday Night Frenzy, High School, Sports

item.title: C-E-C Boys Hockey Snaps Two-Game Skid with Victory Over Mahtomedi
item.description: CLOQUET, Minn.- The Cloquet-Esko-Carlton boys hockey hosted Mahtomedi on Friday night. After a 1-1 first period, the Lumberjacks scored 3 goals to take taking down the Zephyrs 4-2. Up next for the Lumberjacks, they’re back at home on Tuesday, December 23rd, taking on Hermantown. Game time is at 7 p.m. Categories: Friday Night Frenzy, High School, Sports
